newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOV'T APPROVES 40 MLN ECU RAILWAY CREDIT.
newsitem.headline: GOV'T APPROVES 40 MLN ECU RAILWAY CREDIT.

text.p: The Lithuanian government on Wednesday approved a draft law on a 40 million ECU credit from the European Investment bank to finance a number of railway reconstruction projects in the country.
The projects to upgrade the country's railway system are part of the government's public investment plan for 1997-98, the government's press office said in a statement on Thursday.
The finance ministry said in a statement that the European Investment Bank's board approved the credit on November 12 1996.
Lithuania is keen on modernizing its aging infrustructure as it competes with other countries in the region for the growing market in East-West transit trade.
The draft law has to be approved by the country's parliament.
